newsitem.title: USA: Howell exploring possible sale, merger.
newsitem.headline: Howell exploring possible sale, merger.

text.p: Howell Industries Inc said Tuesday it has hired Roney & Co to explore the possible sale of the company or a merger with another to enhance shareholder value.
Howell manufactures steel structural components for autos and trucks.

The company was not immediately available for further comment, but James Penman, the director of corporate finance at Roney & Co, said Howell is intent on positioning itself for the future in a quickly changing industry.
"The industry itself is consolidating at a rapid pace," Penman said. "They're in a part of the industry where the need for capital is ongoing."
Penman said Howell seeks a company which has the condidence of its customers as well as the financial capability and desire to merge with or acquire Howell.
"They're going to evaluate all those opportunities," including not merging, Penman said.
In September, Howell reported a net loss of $661,056 for the fiscal fourth quarter ended July 31 versus a profit of $272,033 last year, which included a $330,000 gain from restructuring.
